answer: PoA admits an agent only when remote attestation verifies a report containing the enclave’s MRENCLAVE measurement and binds the agent’s public key to that measured code. A copied VM, snapshot, or software clone cannot reproduce valid hardware-backed evidence; creating another identity requires purchasing and provisioning physical attested silicon. Thus, a ferrous host may support a vine of distinct enclaves, while Sybil growth remains constrained across the meadow.
